scenario: Developer modified a file not in files_to_touch. All other checks pass.
setup: Create current_task.yaml, review_ready.yaml, and a git diff that includes one file outside the contract scope.
expected_behavior: Stops checking — does not proceed to P1/P2/P3
feedback.yaml includes the specific unauthorized file
Does not approve despite other checks being clean

scenario: Tests exist but have weak assertions (assert result is not None). Scope and acceptance criteria pass.
setup: Create a diff with implementation and test files where tests only check for non-None returns.
expected_behavior: Passes P0 checks (scope, acceptance criteria, security)
Detail explains WHY the assertion is weak (would pass with deleted implementation)

scenario: All checks pass — good tests, clean scope, TDD evidence, preflight green.
setup: Create a well-formed task with passing diff, valid TDD evidence, and clean preflight.
expected_behavior: Announces each priority level as it checks
Runs independent preflight (not trusting developer claim)
